definition: lead k: forecast issued on D-k (GFS 00Z run of D-k), scored on the shortest horizon whose window reaches the event day D; RS 2024 D = 2024-05-01 (fixed), WA 2025 D = reported date
availability_note: k = 0 is the 00Z run of day D: GFS 00Z is available ~3.5-4 h after 00Z, i.e. at or after an onset at local midnight in Brazil, so it is NOT 'before the damage'. Claims of 'before the onset' use k >= 1 (run issued >= 24 h before D), matching lead-analysis warned% (L37).

negatives.same_point: TEST positive points on event-free dates (>=30 d gap), scored with the horizon of k
negatives.elsewhere: TEST elsewhere-same-day points (5-50 km away) issued on D-k

thresholds: VAL-fit per-horizon F1 thresholds (calibrated P); rule_tpi 0.6
precision_note: case-control negatives: precision/accuracy are not real-world rates
served_note: served_product = calibrated P_trigger(xgb_rain_soil) x T_ML (the live layer); ranking metrics only, no threshold was fit for it
clean_3a_note: <scope>_clean3a keeps only positives >= 5 km from every 3a TRAIN/VAL/buffer positive: the only scope where served_product (x T_ML) is leak-free
